Cell.Data: #osotc_elwenhus;近在咫尺，[P=1]那些乐观主义者， [P=0.3]那些所谓的公平正义，[P=0.3]那些漂白的头发[P=0.5].[P=0.5].[P=0.5]. [P=0.5]哦这味道让我恶心！
Introduction to the player character Alucart.
#osotc_elwenhus; is just up ahead.[P=1] The optimism,[P=0.3] the righteousness,[P=0.3] the hair bleach[P=0.5].[P=0.5].[P=0.5]. [P=0.5]The smell sickens me.
曾经，我很欣赏这块美丽的土地，但现在，[P=0.5]只有 一件事迫使我不得不回到这里...[P=0.5]找到他，[P=0.5]终结一切！
Introduction to the player character Alucart.
Once, I might have appreciated its beauty, but that time has long since passed. [P=0.5]Only one thing calls me here now... [P=0.5] To find him --[P=0.5] to end this!
我猜我们要下岗了，连#osotc_quarrel_short;这种 历史遗留问题都能出现转机！
Guess we'll be out of work now that #osotc_quarrel_short; is all straightened out.
别那么悲观主义，[P=0.5] #Her_Vlad;已经超水平发挥他和事佬 的能力，正在平复各个种族间的矛盾！
Don't be a mope.[P=0.5] #Her_Vlad; has outdone himself patching things up between the races!
Alucart laughs (about the guards' foolishness) from the wings.
啊？那是什么奇怪的噪声？
Guards dialogue (being foolish, as Alucart said) Reference to Metal Gear Solid
别轻易赞扬那种所谓的#osotc_savior;行为！ [P=0.5]我本可以不理会你们这类言论， 但不代表我能够容忍，[P=1]去死吧！

Don't be so quick to praise the actions of your so-called #osotc_savior;![P=0.5] Your petty quarrel might be resolved for now, but the menace that you have invited into your haven is incomparable![P=1] En garde!
派对结束了, 空想主义者们！[P=0.5]让我看看你们有多 享受 #Her_Vlad;那可怜的小把戏，现在，混乱降临！
Party's over, do-gooders![P=0.5] Let's see how well you enjoy #Her_Vlad;'s pathetic little treats, now that Chaos has been invited!
停手，黑暗使者！[P=0.5] 神圣的三族会议岂容汝等染指摧朽！
Paladin encounter. "I demand you cease your attack" is a castlevania reference.
Halt, darkling![P=0.5] I demand you cease your attack on this noble council.
我不是故意惹你生气，圣骑士， 恐怕会议本身并没有你想象的那么"神圣"[P=0.5] 善与恶的界线不是那么容易划分的清！
Alucart replies sarcastically. "bubble" is a reference to the Paladin's immunity aura that is a bubble (reference from World of Warcraft)
I don't mean to burst your bubble, but this occasion is not so noble as you might like to believe.[P=0.5] The balance between good and evil cannot so easily be set askew!
... [P=1] 的清！[P=0.5] 我说的是清楚的清！
Alucart clarifying, no it wasn't a sneeze.
哦，如此不清的口齿跟你浮夸的外表很相称！
Paladin somewhat embarrassed. a reference to "your words are as empty as your soul" -Castlevania
Oh. Well then your words are as empty as your nose.
啊噢！你那虚伪的"神圣"作派使我的牙齿不由 自主地硬了，我想我该尝尝[P=0.5] ...你神圣的脖子！
Alucart ready to attack. He makes another sneeze joke. "a chew" = "achoo".
Ach! Your sanctity sets my blood-thirst boiling. I think I'll just have A CHEW![P=0.5] ...on YOU!
作为和平与尊敬的象征，为了种族大团结， [P=0.5] 我制造了三枚 #osotc_magickrings;！
As a token of peace and respect, and to unite all the races,[P=0.5] I have crafted three #osotc_magickrings;!
一枚戒指给你，#osotc_elfleader;，[P=2.0]高挑纤细的金发者； [P=1.0] 一枚给你，#osotc_dwarfleader;，[P=2.0]粗壮稳健的长须者； [P=1.0] 还有一枚给你，#osotc_humanleader;,中等身材[P=4.0]优雅的[P=0.5].[P=0.5].[P=0.5].额[P=0.1]诶[P=0.2] 华服者！

One ring for you, #osotc_elfleader;, [P=2.0]fair and slender![P=1.0] One ring for you, #osotc_dwarfleader;, [P=2.0]bearded and steady.[P=1.0] And one ring for you, #osotc_humanleader;,[P=4.0] medium-sized and... tasteful[P=0.5].[P=0.5].[P=0.5].l[P=0.1]y[P=0.2] dressed!
阿门![P=1.0]为了确保三族联盟的稳固性,我还制造了#osotc_fourthring;戒指![P=2] 这能确保你们的戒指永远不会欺骗主人， [P=3]我称其为...[P=0.5] #osotc_bestring;，[P=0.5] 我想我该坚持下去...[P=0.5] 为了更安全地保存[P=0.5].[P=0.5].[P=0.5].

Ahem![P=1.0] And to seal the union between the rings and the races, I have also crafted a #osotc_fourthring; ring![P=2] This shall ensure that the power of your rings never deceives you.[P=3] I call it...[P=0.5] the #osotc_bestring;,[P=0.5] and I think I'll hang on to it...[P=0.5] for safe keeping[P=0.5].[P=0.5].[P=0.5].
Dwarf cannon encounter introduction. Dwarf confuses Alucart (a vampire) for Vlad (also a vampire). Must be the pale complexion
你居然敢用他·的·名·字叫我？你的傲慢无知亵渎 了神灵!我的愤怒无法容忍!我要剥夺你这渺小的生命， 就像他当初夺走我的一样！
Alucart does not forgive the dwarf's mistake
You dare call ME by HIS name? Your insolence is blasphemy! My fury knows no bounds for the one who destroyed me! I shall steal your mortal life, as he once stole mine.
喔喔喔……对对对对不起！ [P=0.5]你们这些大型人种看起来都差不多！
Wow... Sooorry![P=0.5] You big people all look the same to me!
噢额！好像有点种族歧视。
说够了没！[P=0.5] 我的名字是 #osotc_alucartspec;， [P=0.5] 你挡着道了，[P=0.5]准备好去死吧！
"Enough talk" - Castlevania reference "My name is , prepare to die" -The Princess Bride reference
Enough talk![P=0.5] My name is #osotc_alucartspec;.[P=0.5] You block my path. [P=0.5]Prepare to die!
死，咿？好吧你得把我们先杀死！
Die, ey? Well you'll have to kill us first!
于是先生们，想好怎么结盟了吗？
So gentlemen, are we ready to stand united?
... 我不认为我们需要这个，[P=1.5] 不如你提供那把剑？
... I don't think we will be needing any of those.[P=1.5] How about you offer that sword of yours instead?
哦？[P=0.5]好的...[P=0.5] 你得到我的剑助战。
Oh? [P=0.5]Very well...[P=0.5] You have my sword then!
Second council cut-scene. The "one ring" joke (one ring to rule them all) from LotR, minced up with the 3 musketeers.
So be it![P=0.5] One for all,[P=1.0] and[P=0.5] all[P=0.5] for[P=0.5] one!
停在那里， 黑暗使者！[P=0.5] 我不会让你干扰三族会议的！ 和平才是当今世界的主题！
Elf arch mage sees Alucart approaching
Stop right there, advocate of darkness![P=0.5] You will never disrupt the councils negotiations! There must be peace between the races!
有远比世界和平更重要的东西...[P=2] 好比我的复仇！
There are things more important than world peace...[P=2] like my VENGEANCE!
There are things more important than world peace...[P=2] like my VENGEANCE!
Pedin i phith in aníron, a nin ú-cheniathog.（精灵语）
Elven language from Lord of the Rings. Do not translate. (/'p?.din if 'fi? in a.'ni?.r?n a 'nin u?.x?.'ni.a.??g/) (Eng: I can say what I wish, and you won't understand me)
Pedin i phith in aníron, a nin ú-cheniathog.
Elven language from Lord of the Rings. Do not translate. (/'n?.va?r/) (Eng: Farewell)
我的姐妹们牺牲了？[P=0.5] 她们的死不会白费！ [P=0.5]我还活着，还在呼吸，这扇大门依旧被封印着！
So my sisters have fallen?[P=0.5] Their sacrifices will not have been in vain! [P=0.5]While I still breathe, the gate shall remain sealed!
So my sisters have fallen?[P=0.5] Their sacrifices will not have been in vain! [P=0.5]While I still breathe, the gate shall remain sealed!
我想我该送这位还在呼吸的闹腾家伙去见她的好姐妹!
Then we'll just have to put an end to that breathing nonsense!
Then we'll just have to put an end to that breathing nonsense!
我占卜了你的未来...结局是死亡！
I have looked into your future and I saw death!
啊哈！那是你的结局，我已经看到了！
Aha! Your death then, I should imagine!
...恩，你该在这里签字，[P=1]还有这里跟这里， [P=0.5] 在这里盖个手印，[P=0.5]还有你名字的首字母， [P=0.5]我会尽快把剩下的档案文件尽快交给你。
Alucart and Vlad dialogue before final fight
...so if you'll just sign here, [P=1]here and here, [P=0.5]thumbprint goes here, [P=0.5]and your initials here, [P=0.5]I'll get the rest of the forms out to you as soon as I can.
真是好久不见了，老家伙！
It's been a long time, old one!
我们之间有笔帐要算，相信你记得！
Alucart and Vlad dialogue before final fight
We have a score to settle, as I'm sure you can recall!
还在追索我这条老命吗？[P=1]真正该算账的是你与你自己的 过去，但请你现在别打扰我们，[P=1]这场会议是为了团结 所·有·善·良·阵·营！
Alucart and Vlad dialogue before final fight
Still chasing the same old ghosts? [P=1]The score you need to settle is with your own past, and I must ask you not to disturb us at this time. [P=1] This council is for the good of all!
善良？[P=0.5]你从不是善良阵营的一员！[P=1.0]难道你忘了 你对我做过什么…？[P=1.5]你迫使我对我的家人做了什么？
Alucart says the word "Good" with a sarcastic intonation
Good?[P=0.5] You have never been an ally of Good.[P=1.0] Have you forgotten what you did to me...? [P=1.5]What you made me do to my family?!
你说了你想变成我这样的人...[P=1]我想我可能有一点点 那么过于字·面·意·思地理解了你，[P=0.5]但是对于你的 妻子和儿子，[P=1.5]没人逼你，是你自己那么做的。
Alucart and Vlad dialogue before final fight. "You have done that yourself" - star wars episode 3 reference.

You said you wanted to be like me...[P=1] I suppose there is a slight possibility I MIGHT have taken you a little too literally.[P=0.5] But as for your wife and son, [P=1.5]nobody held a cross to your head. You have done that yourself.
[P=1]我只是尝试转化他们...[P=2]但那种对血液的饥渴实在难 以抵抗！[P=2]是你，你的血族诅咒使我永世孤独！[P=2.5]所以， 为了复仇，[P=0.5]我要把你所珍惜的“善”全数毁灭！
Alucart is saddened by the memory

[P=1]As I tried to turn them as well...[P=2] the thirst was too hard to resist! [P=2]You have cursed me with an eternity of loneliness! [P=2.5]And for that, [P=0.5]all you hold as "Good" must be fought and destroyed!
很好，[P=1]让我们一次性解决这场争端…[P=2]…至死方休！[P=0.5]
Alucart and Vlad dialogue before final fight
Very well. [P=1]Let us settle this once and for all. [P=0.5]
作为你那糊涂个性的标志,[P=1]我会抛起这枚硬币：[P=2] 正面， [P=1]你死，[P=2.5]反面...
Alucart and Vlad dialogue before final fight
As a symbol of your ambiguous nature,[P=1] I'll flip this coin: [P=2] Heads [P=1]-- you die. [P=2.5]Tails ...
a continuation of the previous line, as Alucart looks at the coin he just flipped

H...[P=1.7] How...?[P=1] How is it that I have been so... defeated?
你总是过于自信，#osotc_alucart;，[P=0.5]这也是你失去妻儿的原因， [P=1]你永远学不会如何掌握我赠给你的力量。

Our escorts have met in friendly embrace across all of #osotc_elwenhus;, smiling upon each other, and sharing their tales over good food and drink! Never has this happened since before the days of #osotc_quarrel;.
